bends.note: turns from ESE (about 23 deg) to nearly due east
unlabelled 25' leg from Joe Williams runs SSE and turns east into McMakin; faces continuous, treated as McMakin (key map draws it as one street)

notes: Upper right (x>2900, y<2650) is an inset of St. Anthony's Monastery '7 miles N.W. of city on Colerain Pike' inside a heavy border: not part of the street grid; Delaney, Cherry and Lakeman simply run up to the inset border and continue on 622 (no ends recorded). Colerain / Blue Rock crossing is just off the west edge (centre about x=-100), not recorded. Names printed bare: BLUE ROCK, JOE WILLIAMS (key map has 'So. Williams'), DELANEY, CHERRY, HOFFNER; McMakin printed McMAKIN west of Delaney and McMAKIN ST. east of it, recorded as McMakin Street throughout. McMakin is 25' west of Delaney and only 12' (printed) east of it, and the two parts are offset ~50 px at Delaney; point is the centre of the open crossing. Hoffner is 60' east of Colerain but printed 25' west of Colerain (narrow strip along Wesleyan Cemetery), so the crossing jogs; point is the centre of the open crossing. Cherry: only its west face is drawn (x~6197); centre placed 152 px (25 ft) east of it from the printed 50'. South of Hoffner the Cherry west face steps east to x~6290 (block line), so Cherry/Hoffner is a slightly jogged cross; point is the centre of the open crossing (x~6372, between the north-leg centre 6349 and the south-leg centre). The diagonal strip with the C.H.&D. R.R. tracks at the bottom right is Vandalia Av. (named on 618, unlabelled here): its centreline (taken as the middle of the track set, as on 618) crosses Cherry at (6349,6961) and Hoffner at (5996,7220) and runs on SW off the sheet. Unnamed 12' alley between McMakin and Hoffner runs from a dead end at x~3830 east across Delaney to Cherry. Witler St. (~40') and Lakeman St. (~47') have no printed width.
